correctness.rationale: The quotient and formulas check for every stated n. For M=z^3w^2 u_1^2 ... u_n^2 and T=xu_1, the invariant opens D(1-M), D(M) cover the quotient; upstairs x≠0 is D(1-M)∪D(T) and u_1≠0 is D(M)∪D(T). This justifies the use of the two gauges for the affine invariant quotient, including over other fields. At T=0, E,W',U_i are units and the derivatives with coefficients 2 and 3 cannot both vanish in any characteristic. B=EW' yields E=B^(-2)P^(-1), W'=B^3 P; the equation T=0 trivializes the normal line on a neighborhood of the whole divisor. The preceding term H^(k−1)(U) and following term H^k(U) vanish for k≥2, so the integral Thom–Gysin maps are isomorphisms, with projection and self-intersection giving zero positive-degree products. General position moves loops into the contractible open stratum. The algebraic Gysin map adds one Tate twist. Chow localization generates CH^1 by the divisor, whose primitive integral Gysin class shows infinite order, and kills higher codimensions. The scissor relation and disjoint rational points on the two integral-model strata give the remaining formulas. This is a symbolic proof check; the frozen finite-field verifier was inspected but not executed and does not test the Gysin or Chow assertions.
